user.title: SpinJam
user.description: Select the media players SpinJam should watch. Put higher-priority sources first. When a Sonos/Port source is Line-in, SpinJam uses the vinyl player instead. Optionally pick one or more display TVs to cast to later.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one SpinJam instance is allowed.

error.no_sources: Select at least one source media player.

init.title: SpinJam options
init.description: Update source priority, displays, and lyric settings. Display order is the default cast preference; select.spinjam_display picks which one to use.

start.name: Start SpinJam display
start.description: Select a display and fire spinjam_start for Cast automations.

display.name: Display
display.description: Optional configured media_player to cast to.
